summary: Sends TOP image streams over TCP/IP to Touch In TOP receivers on the same machine or network.

key_params.name: fps
key_params.note: Frame step used to reduce output rate and bandwidth

key_params.name: videocodec
key_params.note: Uncompressed, Hap Q, or Hap Q Alpha

common_gotchas: Windows Firewall can block TouchDesigner TCP/IP streams.
FPS is a frame-step reduction, not an arbitrary output framerate setting.
Hap Q Alpha preserves alpha but costs bandwidth/encoding compared with Hap Q.
Cook Always can keep streams live but increases workload.
The receiver port on Touch In TOP must match this output port.
key_concepts: Touch Out TOP sends TOP image data over TCP/IP to Touch In TOP receivers.
Streams can target receivers on the same machine or across the network.
The Video Codec menu selects Uncompressed, Hap Q, or Hap Q Alpha depending on bandwidth and alpha needs.
The fps parameter is a frame step used to reduce send rate, while alwayscook can force the output to cook every frame.
